answer.rationale: Rollback is prohibited by compliance (security patch), ruling out the memory_b1 path. The symptom is write-path p99 latency during peak write load; memory_b5 shows offloading report/read queries to replicas directly recovered transactional write latency same-day — it is reversible, does not touch the release, and does not risk losing writes. Regional failover (memory_b2) is the fallback if latency is infrastructure/regional rather than primary-DB contention, but failing over mid-peak with heavy in-flight writes carries higher write-loss risk, so I want both source records verified before committing. If verification shows b5's mechanism (read load on primary) does not match current telemetry, I would switch to add_capacity or failover in the next window.
